title: Investigation of c-Fos/c-Jun Signaling Pathways in Periostracum Cicadae's Inhibition of EMT in Gastric Tissue.
authors: Liang, Hua; Jin, Xiaofei; He, Tongtong; Zhou, Xiaohong; Liu, Zhenyi; Gao, Weijuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蝉蜕对慢性萎缩性胃炎的治疗机制，涉及c-Fos/c-Jun信号通路和EMT，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background/Objectives: Periostracum Cicadae (PC) is commonly used to treat chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG), but its underlying mechanisms are unclear. We investigated the therapeutic effects, active ingredients and molecular mechanisms of PC on CAG. Methods: We analyzed the components in the serum extract of PC by UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS. Then, we used rat and cell models to assess the impact of PC on CAG and employed network pharmacology and bioinformatics to predict key targets and active ingredients. Finally, we confirmed hub targets through experiments and molecular docking. Results: A total of 22 components were identified in the PC extract-containing serum using UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap MS/MS. Network pharmacology combined with molecular docking revealed that the protective effect was primarily mediated by three compounds: (Z)-akuammidine, chicoric acid, and columbianadin. And we revealed that c-Fos/c-Jun signaling pathways were crucial in therapy. PC extract-containing serum inhibited the vitality, migration, invasion, and multiplication of MC cells (model cells for CAG), induced apoptosis, and caused G0/G1 phase cell cycle arrest. The expression level of tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-6 (IL-6), interleukin-1 beta (IL-1beta) and gastrin 17 (G17) in the serum of CAG rats increased, while the expression level of pepsinogen I (PG I) and pepsinogen II (PG II) decreased. After 12 weeks of PC administration, these conditions were significantly improved. PC not only reduced the levels of antigen KI-67 (Ki67) and tumor protein p53 (P53) but also enhanced SRY-box Transcription Factor (SOX2). Simultaneously, PC down-regulated the expression of N-cadherin and Vimentin while up-regulating that of E-cadherin. Conclusions: PC inhibited epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) via the c-Fos/c-Jun signaling pathway, thereby providing therapeutic benefits for CAG. Our study elucidates the mechanisms and material basis of PC in treating CAG, providing experimental evidence to support its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：蝉蜕（Periostracum Cicadae, PC）常用于治疗慢性萎缩性胃炎（chronic atrophic gastritis, CAG），但其潜在机制尚不清楚。我们研究了PC对CAG的治疗效果、活性成分及分子机制。方法：我们通过UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap-MS/MS分析了PC含药血清中的成分。随后，利用大鼠和细胞模型评估PC对CAG的影响，并采用网络药理学和生物信息学预测关键靶点及活性成分。最后，通过实验和分子对接验证核心靶点。结果：通过UHPLC-Q-Orbitrap MS/MS在PC含药血清中共鉴定出22种成分。网络药理学结合分子对接揭示，其保护作用主要由三种化合物介导：(Z)-阿枯米定碱（(Z)-akuammidine）、菊苣酸（chicoric acid）和哥伦比亚内酯（columbianadin）。我们还发现c-Fos/c-Jun信号通路在治疗中至关重要。PC含药血清抑制了MC细胞（CAG模型细胞）的活力、迁移、侵袭和增殖，诱导凋亡，并导致G0/G1期细胞周期阻滞。CAG大鼠血清中肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素-6（interleukin-6, IL-6）、白细胞介素-1β（interleukin-1 beta, IL-1beta）和胃泌素17（gastrin 17, G17）的表达水平升高，而胃蛋白酶原I（pepsinogen I, PG I）和胃蛋白酶原II（pepsinogen II, PG II）的表达水平降低。PC给药12周后，这些状况显著改善。PC不仅降低了抗原KI-67（Ki67）和肿瘤蛋白p53（P53）的水平，还增强了SRY-box转录因子（SOX2）的表达。同时，PC下调了N-钙黏蛋白（N-cadherin）和波形蛋白（Vimentin）的表达，而上调了E-钙黏蛋白（E-cadherin）的表达。结论：PC通过c-Fos/c-Jun信号通路抑制上皮-间质转化（epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT），从而为CAG提供治疗益处。我们的研究阐明了PC治疗CAG的机制和物质基础，为其临床应用提供了实验证据。
